feats.title: Initiate of the Old Faith
feats.description: You gain the Druid's wild shape power. Choose a 1st-level Druid at-will attack power that has the beast form keyword. You can use that power once per encounter. In addition, you can wield Druid implements.

feats.title: Hunting Predator
feats.description: While you are in beast form, you gain a +1 bonus to speed.
